summary: Firefly Neuroscience filed an 8-K reporting an Additional Closing under an existing Securities Purchase Agreement, issuing 5,333,333 Units at $1.50/Unit for $8,000,000. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. The filing also describes an Amended and Restated Lock-Up Agreement with a 30-day lock-up ending May 16, 2026, and an extension of the Registration Statement filing deadline to May 21, 2026. No M&A, activist, or restructuring event. This is a standard equity issuance under a prior agreement, akin to a shelf takedown but via a purchase agreement. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for future filings regarding effectiveness of the registration statement.
